summary: Strengthen board governance in the digital and AI era with practical oversight tools, AI risk frameworks, and board-ready reporting.
lede: Digital and AI board governance training helps directors and governance professionals oversee technology, data, cyber, and AI risks. Designed for people who support, challenge, or lead board oversight, it covers assessing governance maturity, clarifying accountability, challenging AI-related decisions, and creating practical board reporting, committee oversight, and risk escalation plans.
audienceIntro: This course is for people who support, challenge, or lead board governance where technology, data, cyber resilience, and AI have become part of the oversight agenda.
modules: Digital and AI board governance context
prerequisites: You should bring a working understanding of board governance, committee structures, or executive reporting. A laptop is recommended for workshop templates, and it helps to have access to a recent board pack, risk register extract, policy summary, or governance report for practical exercises.
